summary: Bumps the actions/cache GitHub Action from v5 (SHA caa296) to v6.1.0 (SHA 55cc83) in the built-package validation workflow.

pr_summary.headline: Bumps the actions/cache GitHub Action from v5 (SHA caa296) to v6.1.0 (SHA 55cc83) in the built-package validation workflow.

walkthrough.text: The sole change is at test-built-package.yml:97, replacing the v5 SHA-pinned reference to actions/cache with the v6.1.0 SHA; inputs path, key, and restore-keys are untouched.
actions/cache v6.0.0 migrated internals to ESM; v6.1.0 adds read-only cache access handling — neither change affects the inputs or outputs consumed by this workflow.
The new SHA is a full 40-character commit hash, consistent with the repo-wide practice of pinning all third-party actions by SHA rather than mutable version tags.
grep confirms this is the only usage of actions/cache in the repository, so no lockstep update to a peer workflow is required.

verdict_reasoning.deciding_factor: Nothing blocks the merge: the change is a single SHA-pinned action bump where the v6 interface is backward-compatible with the v5 inputs used here, and no other file requires a lockstep update.
